message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, type assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming request data (e.g., test_ratio, text, args, params) or to the CSV data loaded from disk before processing.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path (dataset/example_dataset.csv) with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication; no remote source fetching is present at all.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline only applies text cleaning and train/test splitting; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering steps to guard against poisoned samples.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are instantiated directly from sklearn/xgboost constructors (e.g., RandomForestClassifier(), LinearSVC()) with no loading of pretrained weights or serialized files, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected label distribution validation: No class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection is performed before or during training; the data is split and fed directly to fit().
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, there is no isolation enforcement (e.g., the test set is stored in a mutable session, no hashing/signing of evaluation data), and only a single evaluation call is made with no independent metric verification.
No detected input sanitization: The /predict endpoint extracts 'text' and 'args' directly from the JSON request and passes them to the model without any shape, type, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict and evaluate endpoints return model outputs directly via jsonify without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text input, there is no prompt-injection filtering, content moderation, or jailbreak detection applied to the input or output in the inference path.
